history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration improve scrutiny of open commitments at year-end in line with the provisions of the Financial Regulations and Rules to ensure timely surrender of unencumbered balances to the Member States.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers that the recommendation was fully implemented for 2016–2017 and should be closed, based on the improvement in the amount of savings with regard to prior period commitments compared with previous bienniums. Notwithstanding this, it should be noted that the Administration will continue to strengthen review and monitoring of commitments.
history.board_assessment: The Board notes the progress by the Administration, but holds that a significant amount was surrendered for the biennium 2016–2017 and that also commitments amounting to $3.2 million were still open. The Board therefore considers this recommendation as under implementation.
